Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Spring Hill for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Pasco Celebration of Lights) through December 27, with the Christmas Photos with Therapy Draft Horses at Marker 48 (November 29), Winter Waterland at Weeki Wachee Springs State Park (December 11, 12, 18 and 19) and the Weeki Wachee and Hernando Beach Christmas Boat Parades (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Spring Hill

  • 11 Christmas events for kids in Spring Hill
  • 2 free events: the Inclusive Breakfast with Santa and the Weeki Wachee Christmas Boat Parade
  • Meet Santa: Inclusive Breakfast with Santa (December 13), Breakfast with Santa at Weeki Wachee Springs (December 12 and 19) and Pasco Celebration of Lights in Shady Hills
  • Parades and tree lightings: Weeki Wachee Christmas Boat Parade and Annual Hernando Beach Christmas Boat Parade (both December 12)
  • Trains: holiday train rides at Pasco Celebration of Lights in Shady Hills ($4 per rider)
  • Season: November 27 to December 27

Planning a bigger day out? Spring Hill families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Tampa, which covers Christmas Town at Busch Gardens, Christmas in the Wild at ZooTampa and the Winter Village at Curtis Hixon.
